tieu_de: Fullstack Developer ReactJS, Angular, NodeJS, Python
ten_cong_ty: CÔNG TY TNHH SOCOTEC VIỆT NAM
mo_ta_cong_viec:
SOCOTEC Vietnam is a technical support platform for the SOCOTEC Group providing expert services on a range of projects in testing, inspection and certification (TIC) in the construction and infrastructure sectors. Around the globe, more than 15,000 experts in 27 countries across 5 continents deliver professional services in construction, buildings & real estate, infrastructures, environment & safety and certification. 
We are currently expanding our SOFTWARE & IT SERVICES and are looking for a Fullstack Developer to join our growing team and help deliver high-quality projects to our clients.
As a full stack developer, you will support the internal SOCOTEC Group in developing exciting solutions that change the way we support our clients. Integrated to our Development department, you will work in a collaborative, welcoming environment where new ideas drive technological transformation.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
Contribute to the development of the Developer team with the latest innovation
Adaptive to ambiguity and willing to change in a fast-paced environment
Hands on experience with web development
yeu_cau:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience
3 to 5 years of experience in Fullstack development with React / Angular for frontend and Node.js for backend
Minimum 2 years Python experience
Proficient in PostgreSQL databases system
AWS experience is appreciated (Lambda, S3, SQS)
Familiar with controlling tool such as Git/GitHub/GitLAB
Good proficiency in verbal and writing in English. French or other languages are highly appreciated
Experience using modern collaboration tools in a highly responsive environment
Working as a team spirit, proactive communication, consciously curious and motivated character
quyen_loi:
Attractive salary and bonus with annual revision
Compulsory insurance pay as gross monthly salary
42 hours per week (30 minutes early finish every Friday), flexible working hours options
15 annual leave days (Women) & 13 annual leave days (Men) - increasing with length of service & seniority, 15 working from home days each year
Team-building activities, Sport Clubs
Cooperation with colleagues around the world in a leading global group
Strong team spirit in an entrepreneurial environment of a growing company
People values, social responsibility and sustainability
Opportunities for self-development and career advancement
Internal training courses (technical, foreign language, soft-skill)
